name: bangumi-plus-music-preview
description: Bangumi music subject preview userscript powered by NetEase Cloud Music.

scripts.build: npm run build:userscript && npm run build:bgm && npm run build:bgm-local
scripts.build:userscript: tsc -b && vite build --config vite.userscript.config.ts && prettier --write dist-userscript/bangumi-plus.user.js
scripts.build:bgm: tsc -b && vite build --config vite.bgm.config.ts && prettier --write dist-bgm/bangumi-plus-bgm.js
scripts.build:bgm-local: tsc -b && vite build --config vite.bgm-local.config.ts && prettier --write dist-bgm-local/bangumi-plus-bgm-local.js
